goals.goal: TinyTask, as controller of customer account data and processor of customer task data, maintains a single record of processing activities covering both roles, in writing or electronic form, containing the Art. 30(1)(a)–(g) content items, made available to the supervisory authority on request; the Art. 30(5) 250-employee exception does not apply because processing is continuous (SaaS) and not occasional.
goals.adjustment: Restated at 8-employee scale: one entity holds both controller and processor roles, so a single RoPA suffices; the 250-employee exception is explicitly assessed and inapplicable (continuous SaaS processing of names, emails, passwords, task data); no special-category data per fact sheet.

goals.goal: TinyTask, as manufacturer of a default-class product with digital elements (SaaS platform + web/mobile interface) placed on the EU market under self-assessment (Module A), draws up the Annex VII §1–§8 technical documentation before placing on the market, draws up the EU declaration of conformity, affixes the CE marking, and keeps the technical documentation and EU declaration at the disposal of market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years or the support period, whichever is longer.
goals.adjustment: Restated for default-class self-assessment manufacturer: no notified-body involvement; Annex VII 8-item content list applies in full; 10-year or support-period retention (whichever longer) is the continuing obligation; no AI/ML components to document (rule-based platform per fact sheet).
